detailed_descriptions.en: Become a sneaky tentacle monster and haunt the halls of a busy school. Hide inside lockers and leap out at the perfect moment to grab passing characters and score points. The more characters you catch, the more money you earn. Cause playful chaos everywhere! The game features simple side-scrolling gameplay with intuitive controls that are easy to pick up. Move between lockers, time your actions carefully, and choose the perfect moment to strike. Miss your chance and everyone will run away. How many can you catch? Use your hard-earned cash to unlock fun cosmetic upgrades, including themed decorations for the halls and playful accessories for the students. The game features multiple character designs that become more varied as you unlock cosmetic accessories. Switch between different halls for greater variety. New exclusive content! 2 Brand New stages! A maid cafe and an outdoor sports area. Have fun with the girls in their awesome new outfits and hand drawn animations.
